dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Wamkelekile kwiKhomitjhini yoPhenyo, Sbu. I-Berth 14 ivule ibhokisi lethemba ethekwini, ngalokho isigungu sinqala thina nabameli abembethe isilika kanye nemiyalo yokuvala umlomo yoMnyango Wezokuphepha Kwezwe."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Okubi khulu nakakhulu, sithethe imininingwane yezindiza kusuka e-King Shaka International. Indiza ye-ZS-900—i-Gulfstream eyisiqhema—ibhethelwe e-Hangar 7 ukuze ikhiphele uZuko, Ma-Sibi, kanye no-Mokoena e-Dubai."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Imibukiso emibili eqakathekileko: Okokuqala, iSovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed evela kuma-Ridge Penthouses efakazela ukuthi bonke abathathu banesabelo sesigungu lesi. Okwesibili, iMidlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry evela emalolini wamanzi asentshonalanga."
"Vula noma ngabe ngikuphi ukuqhuba ukuze uveze i-Citrus Estate kanye ne-King Shaka Hangar 7—noma uqine zombili uma ufuna ukubamba bonke abantu labo ngamaketanga etamakeni."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Isibaluleko somthetho esimangalisako, Sbu. Lokho kubopha izandla zabashushisi baka-Ma-Sibi abanomkhuba imihla eyongeziweyo yamahora amane nambili kuthi kuphoqe unobhala webhizinisi le-Ridge ukuthi avule incwadi ye-DIFC."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: UZuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "Ulandele amaloli wamanzi woke indlela ukuya phezulu esibungeni, Sbu. Kuyatjheja. Abantu abanengi bayayeka nxa bafika emapenthouse asebhishi e-Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Qalaza i-Packhouse B. Ama-orenji we-Valencia ephezu kwe-conveyor, amaphesenti amane anesithandathu atjhabileko ahlanzekileko wamakristalu wokuphuma phandle emakhrayithini angamani, aqonde ngqo e-King Shaka Cargo Apron. Futhi utheme phakathi kwevuno yami."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Uyethu? Cha, Sbu—siyafakaza kabutjha. Ikhomitjhini Yophenyo idinga isijikelezo, ngalokho uMa-Sibi noMokoena bayethaba. Ngalowo mzuzu, ingqalasizinda esiyakhileko lapha ikhupha izigidi ezingamatjhumi amabili zama-Euro ngenyanga."
"Nxa ufika eHangar 7 naminja, uzokuba nokukhetha: sibophele ilizwe elizokutjhugulula ngelokuwusi, utjise isiteji ngabafana bakaBra Bheki, namkha uthathe okhiye besihlalo wena uqobo."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Abadubuli baseGauteng bayaphuza. Uzuze isihlalo etafuleni, Sbu. Thatha lokhu esefeni sephakhawusi—futhi ucabange kuhle khulu ngaphambi kokuba uvumele uKolonela van der Merwe afake amaketanga ekuseni."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Isibaleki? Njengoba iphesenti elingamashumi amabili nanhlanu leSovereign Pearl Holdings lisemkhomeni we-Dubai, bazokubiza ngokuthi ngumeluleki wezokuphepha kwamazwe ngamazwe! Ngena endleleni yamasondo angaphambili, namkha wenze umdlalo wakho wokugqibela lapha!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Kuya phi i-Unit 3 ne-Unit 5?! Thuka wena, Sbu—uphendulele amaserjenti ami ngaphandle kwekhasi! Wonke umuntu uzisindisa etamakeni!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Ekupheleni kwendlela yezindiza, Sbu! Amamitha we-Gulfstream afudumele, imvume yedipulasi ifakwa, namaphalethi ayalotha amakhrayithi wokugqibela ngaphakathi."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "Usinde ku-N2, usinde ku-Pier 2, futhi usinde eqenjini lami lababulali. Thatha umlayezo wakho ngaphambi kokuba izitebhisi zokubhodla zibuyele emuva!"
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Izimoto ezimbili zamalambu aluhlaza zisibophele ngemva kwendlela yokuphuma ye-Umgeni. UBrigadier Mokoena akazange azifake ne-balaclava. Uphumile ngezambatho zakhe ezitjhisiweko ze-TRT, wathi shono isikhwama sikaSithole, wathi kukhorporali yakhe atjise imoto."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ngigingqikele emthambekeni ngaya emisele yamanzi nginefayela lokuqala le-manila ngaphansi kwevest yakho. Nxa uSparks e-Golden Dragon angaphula iselula kaSithole, izwi likaMokoena lisenkawini leyo yezwi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Lapha—amapuleti ND-449-102 ukuya ku-118. Bakhokhelise uHolo LweDolobha izigidi ezingamatjhumi amane nambili zamaRandi ukuletha amanzi okunatha e-KwaMashu ngesikhathi somQako, kodwa qala amathegi wokuhlawula amafutha. Abazange baphendukele enyakatho."
"Onke amaloli ahambe ngqo aya e-Pier 2 Cold Storage ngo-01:30 ekuseni. Athwala imikhiqizo yamakhemikhali kaZuko Ndlovu ngaphansi kwempahla yamanzi kamasipala."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu Abasanta Maritime, amaphesenti amane wemuli kaMa-Sibi. Ukhone ngempela, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Nikela lokhu kuKolonela van der Merwe endaweni engaphansi ye-Old Archive Basement—namkha utjise i-Berth 14 uqobo. Noma ngabe kuyiphi indlela, abaphunyuki babecacile."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Ungavuli amakhethini, Sbu. Ama-Golf GTI kaMokoena angaziwako ajikeleza i-Anton Lembede Street njalo ngemizuzu emitjhumi amabili. Abazange babulale uAuditor Sithole kwaphela e-Umgeni weighbridge—babemlindile namapharaphu etheku asacleziwe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Konke uSithole afela kuko kungaphakathi kwe-Docket #409 naleso selula esiphuliweko. Tjhono ukuthi asifi kule flabha naminja."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, owake waba liHawk ungena e-Queen Street ngesikhathi abafana be-TRT bakaMokoena baphendula yonke imibhasikidi yesibili e-Warwick Junction. Unesibindi, Sbu, ngizokunika lokho."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Akukho okuhamba ngaphakathi kwe-CBD ngaphandle kokuthi abashayeli bami bakubone kuqala—hhayi amaNjala ase-SAPS, futhi ngokuqinisekilekohhayi amaloli wamanzi kamasipala akhanya athwele nzima ngabo-2 ekuseni."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "Awukhohlwa indlela umgwaqo osebenza ngayo, Sbu. Kwenziwe. Ama-Quantum ami amathathu asanda kubopha imoto yamakhamera ase-SAPS e-Monty Naicker Road. Unesikhala sokuphefumula."
"Thatha lokhu esikhwameni semali yempi yezindlela. Thenga amafutha, fihla umbhali wamabhuku, namkha ulungise uNandi. Qiniseka ukuthi uMokoena uyopha ngokuminyanisa imigwaqo yethu."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Thethelela kuhle. Amaloli lawo anezimpawu zoHolo LweDolobha eminyango, akunjalo? Kodwa abafana bami abasebenza i-Umbilo yokuhlwa bathi amathayi aphansi ngesisindo samadrama wamakhemikhali, nababulali baka-Abasanta bahamba ezimotweni ze-Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "ngaleso sikhathi omame bethu e-KwaMashu bama ngemigqa ngamabhakede emathangeni awomileko. Umphathiswa uMa-Sibi uyathengisa amawodi akhe."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Ngakho i-Hawk enesithunzi ekugcineni ifunde inani lenyama eThekwini. Thatha le mali ethwetshulweko esikhwameni. Gcina ifayela lelo lomsindo likhathele etafuleni likaKolonela van der Merwe, mhlawumbe uZuko uyakuvumela ukuthi uphile ubone iviki elizako."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Yekisa iMoto 4 neMoto 7 esiqeshini se-Victoria Embankment. Wazi njalo ukuthi udlalwa njani umdlalo wamaphepha, Sbu. Jabulela amahora angamatjhumi amabili amane angezelelweko—akuzokusindisa nxa i-Berth 14 ikhishwa."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "I-Durban isebenza ngokuhlelekileko, Sbu. UZuko ugcina amadoko athule, uMa-Sibi ugcina amalambu akhanya eHolo LweDolobha, neQembu Lami Lezisebenzi ligcina ukuthula. UMandla Sithole ucabanga ukuthi i-spreadsheet ingamisa isitimela esithwala impahla."
"Nikela uNandi ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokulala ngoLimi 4, namkha abafana bami abazukuhlupheka ngokungqongqoza emnyango wakho we-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Hawu, hawini. Qala bona sithwani esingene ehhovisi lami lokusebenza. Umisiwe emsebenzini kuma-Hawks, Sbu—ukungenapha kutihlupha ngesifiso sokufa namkha ummeli obiza kakhulu."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Iphi u-Constable Nandi, begodu liphi ibrivifeyi yomphicothi-mabhuku womasipala?"
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Abasebenzi abanamakhono abatholakali kumasipala lo. Kulungile—thatha iphepha lokusebenzisa izintambo zekulumiswano. Uzokufumana lisiya ngqo kucrayini ka-Zuko oseBerth 14 noma kunjalo."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Ukucima kwesibane kuyingozi enkulu, Sbu—ngaphandle kobana uyazi bona yiphi ibhuliki okufanele uyidose nanini. Ngesikhathi iSigaba 6 sifika ePoint Waterfront, amakhamera we-Transnet azenzakalelako avaleka amehlo amahora amane."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Abangani be-City Hall abahlali ebumnyameni. Izigangi zifumana izindlu zazo eziyisithelo zihlaselwe ngaphambi kokana izibane zomwaqo zibuyele ukukhanya."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "U-Mandla Sithole bekangumphicothi-mabhuku ohlakaniphileko ongenalitho lokuzivikela. Wena-ke, ngapha kwalokho, uyayizwisisa indlela yokuzisiza."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Nasi isibambo samalandu se-Rand ezinkulungwane ezihlanu esisuka esikhwameni semali yesigodi. Gcina igama letu lokuqiniseka lingena emaphephandabeni, nehhovisi lami lingakwazi nokusebenzisa i-grid ye-Eskom nakudingeka ukuba kube nobumnyama."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: USekela "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Vala umnyango, mntwanami, umswakama wonakalisa imahogani. Wonke umuntu emzini lo ukhonona nakuba i-grid yehla iya kwiSigaba 6, kanti akekho obuzako bona ngubani ohlawulela ezombusazwe zemibuthano."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "Ubekade uhogela eduze kwe-Procurement Registry B. Ngitjele bona umphenyi owahlulekileko ufuna ukuthini ngengqalasizisekelo yamanzi aphuthumako."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Yebo, i-Central Precinct bekine-stingray tower ebambelele kwi-SIM serial yakho endala. Ngiguqule i-baseband MAC address yakho ukuze ibonakale njengemitha yokupaka yamasipala. Nwela phezulu!"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "USithole bekangasi ngumphicothi-mabhuku kwaphela—watshala imakrofoni ehamba ngendlela ngaphakathi kwe-Pier 2 Cold Storage. Ngaphambi kokana batshaye imoto yakhe ku-N2, ucingo lwakhe luthathe umlayezo wezwi wemizuzwana engamashumi amane nesihlanu kanye ne-manifest yamakhethe ye-MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Qaphela ukucima kwesibane kweSigaba 6 kodwa. Ngaphandle kokana usebenzisa ijeneretha yakho ye-diesel yesikhungo esiyisithelo, i-rig yami enkulu yokuvula imilayezo ilahlekelwa amandla we-grid."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.role: Umkhuzi Wezinto Zokusebenzisa Nemithala • Ubuchwepheshe Bemakethe Emnyama
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Qaphela intambo yokukhubekisa eseduze kwesitendi sameva, Sbu! Ukunyuka kwamandla kagesi kweSigaba 4 kusanda kutjhisa ama-oscilloscope ami amabili, begodu izigangi zecala lobuchwepheshe zikaMokoena zibekade zithumela imiyalezo kuzo zonke izibhida zemibhoda phakathi kweGrey Street neTheku."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: " Uphathe isitina se-GraphemeOS sikaMandla Sithole? Ucingo lolo lunohlelo lwe-Abasanta lokwesula olukude oluhlala ku-baseband chip."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Qala isikhathi samandla kagesi leso—sidlule isitifiketi sokuqala samandla womzimba ngaphandle kokubangela ukuba uhlelo lwe-Abasanta lokwesula lusebenze. Omunye umzamo ohlambulukileko ebhentshini begodu umatshina lo ngowakho."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: UZuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Qala ngesiteshi, Sbu. Imikhumbi emashumi ayisithandathu elindile endaweni yokumisa, amakhethe ayizinkulungwane ezintathu ngosuku, begodu iPitoli icabanga bona iphepha elisayinwe ngumantshi lilawula itheku leli."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ngakha i-Abasanta Logistics kusuka esitolo esisodwa sokugcina izinto ezibandayo. Manje wena umi phezu kwe-catwalk yami unebhuku lamalandu lomphicothi-mabhuku oshonileko. Uze lapha ukuzodlala uqhawe, namkha uze lapha ukuzwisisa ukunikezwa nokufunwa kwezinto?"
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Ndoda ehlakaniphileko. Ama-Hawks akuhlawule imali encane akujulela emargweni nawusondela kakhulu eqinisweni. Cabanga lokhu njengenzuzo yakho yokuqala evela ku-Berth 14. Nasifika isikhathi saphakathi kobusuku, qiniseka bona umkhumbi lo uyahamba."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Akumangalisi bona iqembu lokubulala likaMokoena likuphosile ku-N2. Unyakaza njengentuthu yasethekwini. Tjela uTitus ngikhansile izinja zakhe zokulinda itheku ngobusuku obunobu—nasizohlola omunye nomunye, mawube ngaphandle kwabantu abangenamava."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "I-City Hall yebiwa isabelomali samanzi iminyaka elitjhumi ngaphambi kokana ngiqashe itanka, Sbu. Ngivele ngerajisa amamoli abo angenalutho. Kulelizwe, ingqalasizisekelo ingeyalowo ogcina i-diesel naye ohlawula abalindi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "UMokoena uyisithulusi esingacijangako, noMa-Sibi ungumhlaseli. Ngisiza ngihlanze i-Berth 14 namhla ebusuku, begodu ngeze waphinda wahlupheka ngelenti e-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: UColonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: I-DPCI Hawks Holdout • Ithimba Lomsebenzi Elihlambulukileko
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "Udlulile kumakhamera wenkantolo kamantshi, Sbu. Kuhle. Ingxenye yeHhovisi Elikhulu Lesifunda ikwiforomani kaMokoena, yikho ngithuthele ithimba lami lomsebenzi lapha phansi nemitjhini yemicrofiche yabo-1980."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "Ubonakala unjengeSihogo, mntwanami—begodu ngizwa bona u-Constable Nandi uthathe isibunu ku-N2. Ngitjele bona uphathe okuthileko okungasinda kumahluleli weNkantolo Enkulu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Nkulunkulu omuhle... 'thatha isedani yakhe ngaphambi kwe-Umgeni off-ramp ube uthise ibrivifeyi.' Lelo lilizwi likaTitus Mokoena, lizwakala kahle khulu."
"Ngibeka imoto yakho kuhlu lwethu lwezamanqophiso zombuso manje ukuze sicoshe ukufudumala kweSikhungo sakho. Hlala uphila kuze kube siyasakaza lokhu, Sbu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Ngoba njalo nangenza iwaranti phezulu, umuntu oMnyangweni uyaxwayisa i-City Hall ngaphakathi kwemizuzu elitjhumi nanhlanu. Ngaphandle kwembiko wezimali KANYE nomsindo we-Berth 14, umshutshisi uzolahla icala ngaphambi kwesidlo sakuseni."
"Nasize sithumele ipakeji ephelele iqonde khona eThe Daily Veld newsroom, siphinde sifinyelele ukuvikela uNandi njengomfakazi, ngeze bakwazi ukuyifica."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "Thatha lokho. Bekisa ukufutheka kwakho elabhoratri enkulu kaZuko eMidlands namkha kubabulali bakaMokoena—yeka umkhwekazi abuyele evila lakhe lokuphelelwa msebenzi ePalm Jumeirah."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Soke osopolitiki abahlakaniphileko beKwaZulu-Natal bazi bona iRandi yenzelwe ukusetshenziswa kanti iDirham yenzelwe ukubekwa. I-Sovereign Pearl ibambe indlu eDubai, ipulasi lelemula eMidlands, nesibindi sokubhabha eHangar 7."
"UZuko unamaphesenti ama-45, mina ngibambe ama-30, kanti uTitus Mokoena unamaphesenti ama-25 ngokugcina imibhamu ibhekiswe kude nathi."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "Uthathe iterminali ye-escrow? Uyiqinisile ngempela indaba yokungaphezi. Kulungile—abashushisi abaphatha iWaranti Yokusilela Ngesigwebo bakukhombisa isigebengu sami. Ngizokutshela bona behlise isivinini sefayili yakho yokuboshwa."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: UMasibhuku "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Umoya uhlanzekile khona lapha phezulu eRidge, akunjalo, Sbu? Phansi eCBD banesigungu sabo seKhomitjhi yoBulungiswa, benza ngathi umahluleli otholileyo angayisombulula iminyaka eminyengi yokusekelwa komasipala."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Iimpahla zami sele zikhona eKing Shaka Hangar 7. Kubayini ukhwela umbhoshongo wami wegilasi isiphepho sesisondele?"
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Boke abantu aba! Phakathi kuka-1:00 AM no-4:00 AM, esikhundleni sokupompa amanzi esibungwini, amaloli la akhwele iN3 ukuya ekhaya lemila yamakhabe eceleni kweHowick spur."
"Hlanganisa imininingwane leyo ye-telemetry, Sbu, uzabe usuwazi indawo kanye nelabhoratri enkulu kaZuko."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Nazi i-flash module evela eTanker #14! Futhi ungakhathazeki ngababulali abavela eJoburg—nanyana ngisiphi isidansi esingena ngasentla sivalelwa ngama-Quantums amatjhumi amane ngaphambi kokuthi balethe umagazini."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Umphathi Wesiteleka Samanzi Sentshonalanga • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Qala amaloli la esiwathumbile izolo ebusuku, Sbu! Amagabha afakwe ngaphakathi—omile njengefambo esingeni samanzi, kunye nezinsalela zamakhemikhali ngaphakathi."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Abantu abasezintabeni zenyakatho sebaqedile ukulinda amakhomitjhi aseNkantolo Enkhulu. Abashayeli bami bavalile idipho, kanti izinkabi zikaMokoena zangaphandle kwesifunda ziyazula endleleni zikufuna."
dialogue.new_lead_title: Imininingwane entsha noma umkhondo wobufakazi uyatholakala!
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Vala amasango yedipho, Bra Bheki. Siyisa impi endlini yabo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Amaloli aboshiwe abesanesibonisi se-GPS esisebenza kakuhle emgodini wawo?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "Asikhuphe ama-chip we-GPS ku-Lead Tanker #14 khonapha sizakhe ababukeli bezakhamizi ngokumelene neqembu lababulali."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Kutheni abashayeli benu basesikhathini sasebusuku bathini ngamaloli kamasipala?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Ulwazi oluhle. Asikhulume ngelinye indaba."
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Gcina amalambu akho aphansi, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Hlonipha, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Lelo lihlelo elalahlekilekile phakathi kwechweba nesikhumulo sezindiza."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Umanyano lwe-Queen Street luma ndawonye. Angithi isigungu singangincedisa ngemali yokusebenza?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "Kuzoya ngqo ekudililizeni umkhumbi wabo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Amaphoyisa enu angebhasikidi angikweletela kusuka kuvumelwano lwezindlela zaseBerea. Susa izinombolo zami zokuhamba kubabukeli bakaMokoena."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Ukwahlukana okuthathu okuhle."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ngineshedyuli yobunikazi obuzuzisayo, Ma-Sibi. Thenga isihlalo sakho ngaphandle kweshidi lami lamacala."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "Ungangeni kwi-Gulfstream leyo okwamanje, Mhlonishwa."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: UMKANKASO UQEDILE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): Usindile emnyameni wokucima kwamandla, wavumbulula umbhobho weSovereignment Pearl, wabe wahlulela abaphathi abangathintekako be-eThekwini-Gold.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: Nj kuthi i-Gulfstream ZS-900 ijikele endleleni yamajethi, izimoto ezine ezingaziwako zama-Hawks nelori yesiphathamandla seNkantolo Ephakeme zivimba amavili angaphambili. Uphuma uya ekukhanyeni okuvame ukumfiphaza amehlo uphethe isitifiketi seSovereign Pearl Trust Deed kanye namarekhodi asendlunkulu yaseMidlands.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: UMpharisi Mokoena uzama ukubamba isibhamu sakhe, kodwa abone amabhamu angamashumi amabili ama-DPCI aqonde ngqo esitebhisini sendiza—kanye nekhamera yokusakaza bukhoma eqonde ngqo kumlayezo wokuphuthumisa weKomitjhini—usehlisa kancane isibhamu sakhe. Umhlonitjhwa Ma-Sibi noZuko Ndlovu behliswa ngezitebisi ezimanzi banegade eliyinsimbi.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: Ngesikhathi sokusa, iNkantolo Ephakeme yakwaZulu-Natali ibeka i-Zululand Aqua-Logistics ngaphansi kwabaphathi benkantolo, amadamu wamalokutjhini asenyakatho avulelwa amanzi ngokuphelele okokuqala ngqa emnyakeni.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Okokuqala ngqa eminyakeni emandla, imilayezo yamapholisa aluhlaza ayizange ihlambulule indlela yezikhulu ezinkulu—zabe zizibopha ngamajele."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: UZuko Ndlovu, umHlonitjhwa Ma-Sibi, kanye noMpharisi Mokoena babhekana namacala angu-142 wokubamba inkohliso, ukuhlubuka, nokubulala phambi kwenkantolo ekhethekileyo.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Amathimba aphenjisisako abamba i-R1.2 bhiliyoni yemali ephephile phesheya kwamazwe abuye adicilele phansi indawo yokulima yaseHowick.

ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: UMKANKASO UQEDILE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): Uphule umbuthano wombuso kusuka phansi uze uyokufika phezulu wabuyisela ubomi be-eThekwini-Gold kubantu bayo.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Esikhundleni sokulinda imiyalo yenkantolo ehamba kancane, usakaza indawo yeHangar 7 nezinkinobho zeSovereign Pearl ngqo emaphoyiseni kaBra BhekiaseQueen Street nakumakomiti wesiteleka samalokutjhini asenyakatho.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Ngaphakathi kwemizuzu erhobhileyo, amatekisi alikhulu namashumi amathathu namalori wamanzi kamasipala abanjwe ngenkani aphula ucingo lwendawo yemithwalo, avimbe iGulfstream ZS-900 endleleni yokundiza. Amasosha kaZuko alahla izibhamu zawo abalekela emasimini womoba.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Ngaphambi kokusa, imali yesigaba sesigidi esingu-R400 yombuthano ithunyelwa ngqo ezinhlanganweni zamanzi zomphakathi, bese amalori amanzi ahlambulukileyo angene eKwaMashu ngemisindo yamajele igubha.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Bebathethe amanzi baze basidayisela isomiso. Namhlanje sibuyisile amalori, ompompi, ne-akhawunti yebhangi."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: IThe Forum yamanzi yase-Northern Township ithatha isilawulo soke samaloli wamanzi kamasipala, iqeda isomiso esenziwe ngabantu ngobushu obunye.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Njengoba ihlutshwe ukuvikela kwe-cartel nemali yayo yokuphungula intela yaphesheya, umanyano kaMa-Sibi uyasula ngobunengi babo phakathi kwemikhosi yemigwaqweni edolobheni loke.

ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: Umaima wedwa emvula eHangar 7 isandla sakho sisesakhiweni sokusakaza esibiyelweko. UZuko Ndlovu ubheka umyalelo weNkantolo Ephakeme esandleni sakho sangasesokunxele nohlelo lwendiza ye-Dubai esandleni sakho sangasesokudla, bese uyancweba bese utlikitha ukudluliswa kweSovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: Ngo-00:05 AM, ubiza amapholisa ahlwitha izinto begodu ubukela iGulfstream ZS-900 ikhuphukela emafini wesiphepho abheke kuLwandle i-Indian Ocean. Ngemva kwemizuzu elitjhumi, uKholonela van der Merwe uthola idokhethi elicociweko elibeka umlandu woke eqenjini kumhloli ofileko.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: Ukusuka esitezi esiphezulu sombhoshobho wengilazi we-Umhlanga Ridge, ubukela Isiteji sesi-6 sicwilisa idolobha elingezansi ebumnyameni—kanti omatshini bakho abazimeleko bayahlabela ngaphandle kokubanyaza.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Imibuso ayiwi nakuba inkosi igibela indiza. Itshintsha kwaphela amasignesha ethempeni lokuthembana."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: NgoZuko, Ma-Sibi, kanye noMokoena abajeziselwe e-Dubai, uthatha isilawulo se-100% seSovereign Pearl Holdings, ama-krane wetweba, nesabelo seMidlands.
Uphenyo lweSimo Sombuso lukhipha umbiko wamakhasi angu-900 ongenamandla oncoma "amatjhuguluko wokuphatha" angenazo izigwebo eziphezulu.
Unamajaji, amaphiko wamateksi, namathenja kamasipala. EThekwini-Gold, ubusuku bungamaphakathi sebungabakho.

ending.ending_kingpin.p1: Ilifti eyimfihlo eya e-The Glass House ikhuphukela ngaphezulu kwamakhreni wamakhabhoni abanda ngomoya opholileko. Zuko Ndlovu uthela amagilazi amabili e-single malt ngesikhathi uBrigadier Mokoena noMphathi Wabasebenzi bakaCouncillor Ma-Sibi babukela uthatha amakhasi okuqala anegazi ledokhethi #409 kanye nedrayivu yomhloli eyayivuliwe uyibeka etafuleni lengilazi.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Umsebenzi wokuhlela kukususa iziphazamiso," usho njalo uZuko ngokuzola, akhangele ngaphandle edolobheni elimnyama. "Uzibonakalisه uqotho kuneqembu loke likaBrigadier Mokoena. Thiya intengo yakho."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: Uzishisela umlilo wena uqobo. Njengoba amaphepha okuqala ohlolo lwamacala aphenduka umlotha, ukumiswa kwakho kusulwa ku-mainframe ye-SAPS, igama lika-Constable Nandi lisulwa ngemporsho yezempilo ethuleko, kanti inkampani yakho entsha yokucebisa inikezwa ama-20% wombhobho we-Zululand Aqua-Logistics.
ending.ending_kingpin.quote: "E-eThekwini-Gold, akukho muntu ohlula umshini. Noma uyacunyuzwa ngaphansi kwamatanka, noma uthenga isihlalo phezu kwevalvu."

intro.pitch: Ebangeni leenyanga ezisithandathu ezidluleko, uBrigadier Titus Mokoena wakubhala phansi wabe wafihla ibheji yakho yamaHawks. Ngobusuku ubusuku, ngesikhathi somnyama womkhawulo wesigaba sesi-4, owayeyimlingani wakho osemutjha ungena ngesiququ tarheni yaseMercury Arcade yakho aphuma igazi elibhalwe silonda sesibhamu—aphethe ilejara elinegazi elibopha amathenda wamaloli wamanzi kaMasipala wezigidi ezingama-R400 ngqo nesigebengu samaphilisi i-Abasanta.
intro.pitch_story2: Ukutshabalaliswa ngendlela eqakathekileko kwamandla wesibane se-Eskom ukuze kuphoqwe amathenda wama-diesel wokuvula okusheshako wezitalada ezingaphakathi, axhaswe ngemali ngabaphathi abakhulu bezokuphepha kwabantu abazimele nabasebenzi abakhohlakeleko baminisi. Umphenyi we-SIU owawuhlaza uKagiso "Bra K" Molefe kufanele angene phakathi khulu emigodini yemayini yaseJohannesburg namaphentawuzi aseSandton ngaphambi kokuthi igridi iwa.
intro.pitch_story3: Amalungelo angakajayelwa wokuqoba amatje wamalwandle angaphakathi, ukugibelana kwezikhali zemida, kunye nabarhwebi bempi abanyenyeza imali yamandla ibe matje wempi yamazwe ngamazwe ekhophele ngamiselweni womkhumbi omlotha weAtlantic ePort Nolloth kunye neRichtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Isivumelwano esihlangene samaphoyisa amakhulu wesifunda, amaqembu wobugebengu beCape Flats ahlangene, kunye nabantu abadala beWinelands abahlomileyo abakhulu ukulawula umnotho wobusuku kunye namasebe okuthumela ngaphandle. Owakade ungusopolisa woMbutho Obalulekileyo Wokulwa Nobugebengu uLeila Hendricks uphenya kusuka eCamps Bay ukuya eStellenbosch cellars.
intro.pitch_story5: Ukudilika okuphelele kweGridi yeBlack-Sky yeSigezo sesi-8 kuzo zonke izifunda ezisi-9. Umbutho weUnited Hawks Taskforce uhlanganisa iinsika ezine zomthetho wesifunda ukuya kuhlasela umhlangano omkhulu weSovereign Octagon eDrakensberg ngaphambi kokuba intando yeningi iqotheke kwaphela.

mission.faq_q1_body: Umjikelezo yiLanga Linye eMdlweni (umsebenzi wamahora amalanga angu-24). Akunomkhawulo onjengamalanga angu-50 namkha angu-100. Kunalokho, uzabalaza ngetwa ezisongelako ezibalelako (njengoMshado kaBrigadier Mokoena wezigaba eziyisi-6). Uphenyo olujayelekileko luthatha imizikilezo emisi-3 ukuya kwisi-6 kwiSenzo 1 kunye nemizikilezo emisi-4 ukuya kwisi-8 kwiSenzo 2.
mission.faq_q2_body: Njalo ekuseni, uphosa amadayisi ama-3 ukuya kwisi-5 ZONKE zedolobha ngokusekelwe ekuzoleni kwakho (80%+ = amadayisi ama-5, 40–79% = amadayisi ama-4, <40% = amadayisi ama-3). Awuwaphosi amadayisi kizo zoke iindawo! Khetha imisebenzi emisi-3 ukuya kwisi-5 emqoka ebalazweni lapho uzokubeka khona umzamo wakho wamalanga.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Mangaki amadayisi engiwafumanako? Ngiyawaphosa na kizo zoke iindawo?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Ukucofa u-Vala Umjikelezo kuphelisa umsebenzi wakho begodu kuthuthukela ekuseni okulandelako:
• Amawotja osongelo ayathuthuka (+1 esigabeni samawotja abomvu).

Ngaphandle kwamafasitela akho anekhefu, imvula enomswakama yasogwini ishaya kabi amaphepha ensimbi yophahla lwe-Mercury Arcade, ekhanyiswa kuphela kukukhanya okuphuzi kwegenerator yedizili yesitolo se-spaza esendleleni.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Etafuleni lakho kukhona ibhodlela lotshwala begoba elingasaphelelanga kanye nencwadi yokumiswa komsebenzi esayinwe ngu-Brigadier Titus Mokoena ezinyangeni ezisithupha ezidluleko.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Kube sekuvela umsindo—hhayi kwi-buzzer esezansi, kodwa ukushaywa okuthathu okukhulu nokumanzi kwi-Trellidor yakho yensimbi etshiselwe phezulu kwesitebhisi somlilo. Ngaphambi kokuba ufinyelele i-9mm Parabellum engaphansi kwesiphingi sakho, khumbula ukuthi wawubani ngaphambi kokuba uMokoena angcwabe umsebenzi wakho:
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: Utjhaja isilayidi seZ88 yakho bese uthathela eceleni komnyango. Ngephophoyili, isibane sesimo esiphuthumayo esitjhajekako siyakhafa phezu kwehembe le-SAPS eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka elimanzi.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: Ngu-Khansela Nandi—nguye kwaphela umntwana omutja esiteshini owala ukusayina ifidavithi yamanga kaMokoena ngawe. Uqina imibambo yakhe yesincotho, igazi elimnyama liyaphuza phakathi kweminwe yakhe, ephethe idokhethi elinsundu elinzima kanye nomakhalekhukhwini oqhekekileko ophasi kwengalo yakhe.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Iwaranti..." uphelelwa ngamandla, amehlo akhe apheka isithunzi sesitebhisi. "Vula isango. Ngiyacela. Ama-TRT van ka-Mokoena asandula ukudlula irinki yeteksi. Nangabe i-radio transponder yami isasasebenza, basezitebhisini ezimbili ngemva kwami."
pnode.scene_2_the_door.role: SAPS Rapid Rail & Highway Patrol (Umntjana Wakho Omdala)
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: Ubeka ithawula elihlambulukileko eceleni kwakhe. Insimbi ye-9mm hollow-point irumbe imibambo yakhe engezansi—ijule ngokwanele ukuthi igazi ligeleze ngokuqhubekako, kuyingozi kakhulu ukuyithunga esibhedlela sombuso lapho abaphathi bamapholisa babhala khona woke umuntu odutshulwe ngesibhamu.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: UNandi uphose Idokhethi #409 nomakhalekhukhwini ogcwele igazi ezandleni zakho. "Besiphendula ubugebengu be-Cash-in-Transit ku-N2 south ramp emva kwesigidi sokuhlwa. I-G4S van iqhuma nge-C4 yebhizinisi, Wewaranti. Kwaphela akukho zikhwama zemali ezibekwe hlangana."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: Ugwinya kanzima, athuthumela. "Bekunomhleli womasipalala ofileko ovalelwe ngamaketango aphansi kwamakheji, kanye nencwadi le. Amakhulu amane wamabhiliyoni wamaRandi amathenda wamanzi aphuthumayo adluliselwe ehhovisi lika-Khansela Ma-Sibi aya ngqo emaphothweni wemikhumbi ka-Zuko Ndlovu. Ngesikhathi umlingani wami ezama ukukufaka kudespatja, uBrigadier Mokoena wafika ngebhakisi le-TRT elingenamabala... wamdubula esifubeni."
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: UNandi uwa phansi kusofa wakho njengoba ilanga lasekunene livutha ngamajweli. Ngaphandle, iimtekisi zokuqala ziyaqala ukukhala e-Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: Unezingqinamba ezimbili ezibalulekileko: Inxeba lesibhamu sikaNandi lizabola kungakapheli izinsuku ezine ngaphandle kokuthi ubhadle udokotela ongekho emthethweni (R1,500), kanye namaqembu e-TRT kaBrigadier Mokoena asesha isifunda ngeSifunda ngebhloko.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Ezandleni zakho kuhlala ubufakazi obuhlanganisa iHholo Ledolobha, i-SAPS Organized Crime, kanye ne-Abasanta Cartel. Amadayisi akho wamalanga alungele etafuleni.

tutorial.step1.badge: ISIGABA 1 KUSUKA KU-6 // IBHAMA ENGEZANSI & NOMELULEKI
tutorial.step1.bullet1: Cindezela nayiphi indida ekudeni engezansi ukuze uyibambe—zonke iSikhala sokuSebenza zibonisa ngokukhethekileko inani lakho elifakwe isandiso (Okuhlaza okotjani 6+, Okomthubi 4–5, Okovuvu 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: Awuqiniseki bona wenzeni okulandelako? Landela "Ummeli Wokusebenza" kuPhanele YeNingizimu namkha khangela izibonakaliso ezikhazimulako ze-"★ Recommended" emagxabeni wemephu nezikhala zokusebenza.
tutorial.step1.bullet3: Nawuphelelwa ziindida zokusebenza zelanga, cindezela "Qeda Umjikelezo / Lala →" ukuze uye ekuseni okulandelako.
tutorial.step1.desc: Ekufeni kwelanga kuMjikelezo ngamunye (Ilanga), umphenyi wakho uphosa iinkamba zokusebenza eziyi-3 ukuya ku-5 ezinehlangothi ezisithoba ngokwesimo seComposure samanje (80–100% = iindida ezi-5, 40–79% = iindida ezi-4, <40% = iindida ezi-3). I-Composure yimikhosi yakho yengqondo namandla wokulwisana nezwe elimnyama le-eThekwini.
tutorial.step1.title: Isigaba 1: Iindida zokuSebenza zeLanga & ne-Composure
tutorial.step1.zone: Iindida zokuSebenza zeLanga, i-Composure & noMmeli Wokusebenza
tutorial.step2.badge: ISIGABA 2 KUSUKA KU-6 // UMDWEBI OSEMKHATHINI WESIDLELE
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Ukuphela koPhoso = Ubuso beNdida + Isilungisi se-Stat + I-Stage 6 Bonus + Iimpahla zokuVikela.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: isi-6 namkha ngaphezulu (Okuhlaza okotjani — Ukusebenza Okuhlambulukileko): Kuqhubekisa amaWotjha woPhando ngoosiba ababili namkha kuhlawula imali ephezulu ngaphandle kwethrekhi.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: isi-4 namkha isi-5 (Okomthubi — Ukusebenza Okonakalisiweko): Kuqhubekisa amawotjha ngoosiba olunye namkha kuhlawula imali, kodwa kubiza i-Composure encane.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: isi-1 ukuya ku-3 (Okovuvu — Ukuhluleka / Ukubuyiselwa): Akukho mfuneko, ukulahlekelwa yi-Composure, kungeza uBundini beSitilandi.
tutorial.step2.desc: Bamba namkha cindezela indida evela esikhwameni sakho sezingeni elingenhla, bese ucindezela iSikhala sokuSebenza kunoma ngabe yikuphi okusemgwaqweni ovulekileko. Ukuphepha kusebenza ngokuqinileko: Inani leNdida + Isilungisi se-Stat + Isilungisi se-Stage 6 Blackout + Isigwebo seSipha Esimbi. Izigaba ziyabonakala: 6+ Ukusebenza Okuhlambulukileko, 4–5 Okonakalisiweko, 1–3 Ukuhluleka.
tutorial.step2.title: Isigaba 2: Ukubeka Iindida kuMakhaya wokuSebenza
tutorial.step3.badge: ISIGABA 3 KUSUKA KU-6 // UMNOTHO & NAMANDLA WOKUVUSELELA
tutorial.step3.bullet1: Isitolo seMpahla zoMnyama (HUD Engezansi): Thenga izinto ezingapheliyo eziqinileko e-Golden Dragon namkha e-Point Road (+1 WIRE, +1 STREET, -50% ye-Trauma, namkha Ukudlula Ngaphandle Kwesandiso Sezingcingo).
tutorial.step3.bullet2: 1/Ilanga Icingo LokuSebenza kweFaksi (Phanele YeNingizimu): Finyelela ku-+1/+2 Rep nefaksi ukuze uvule amandla wamahhala wanga-onke amalanga (Phoqelela i-Stage 6, +2 WIRE boost, namkha -2 Threat Clock segments).
tutorial.step3.bullet3: Ukuvuselelwa kwe-Safehouse & Nokuhlola kweNgcwanisi: Sebenzisa amaRands kuma-Trauma Patch-Ups (+25% Composure), Shabeen Hustles, Diesel Overrides (R300), kanye ne-Roadblock Bribes (R200).
tutorial.step3.desc: Amandla we-Eskom ajikeleza kusuka ku-Stages 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 ubusuku ngabunye. Ngesikhathi se-Stage 6 Blackouts, izikhala zeseva zobuchwepheshe ziyavaleka ngaphandle kokuthi usebenzise i-R300 ku-Backup Generator Diesel, kodwa imisebenzi eyihlambalazo e-Port nase-Estates ithola i-+2 Roll Bonus ngaphansi kokufihlakala kobumnyama.
tutorial.step3.title: Isigaba 3: Ukuvalwa Kwamandla (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step4.bullet1: Ukuhlulwa / Ukubanjwa (Umdlalo Uvaliwe): Uma i-"TRT Raid Sweep" kaBrigadier Mokoena (Act 1) namkha "Hawks Taskforce" (Act 2) ifike ku-6/6, i-safehouse kaSipho iyangenwa futhi umdlalo uphela ngokubanjwa.
tutorial.step4.bullet2: UkuQothulwa kwe-NPC (Constable Nandi): Uma "Nandi’s Bleedout" ifika ku-4/4 ngaphambi kokuba umqinise, uConstable Nandi ufa nya endlini yakho ephephileko (-30% Composure).
tutorial.step4.bullet3: Ukwehla kwe-Composure kuya ku-Zero & neziVumelwano zokuziphindisela: Ukufinyelela ku-0% Composure kuvula ukuhluleka okuphuthumayo okubiza indida enye ngelanga elilandelako. Ukwehlisa i-Faction Rep kuya ku--2 kuvula ukuziphindisela okuhlomele.
tutorial.step4.desc: Amacala ajikelezako abonisa inhlekelele ezayo (Sweep kaBrigadier Mokoena, Inxeba likaNandi, Izinkabi Hit Squads) futhi alandela impumelelo yakho yobugebugebu (Docket #409 Audit, Phone Cracking, Berth 14 Convoy). Uma amawotjha wophenyo agcwala, amaqhinga wokuphela ayavuleka.

tutorial.step5.badge: ISIGABA 5 KUSUKA KU-6 // HUD ENGEZULU & NEMEPHU
tutorial.step5.bullet1: Ukuvalwa kwe-Stage 6: Iiseva zekhompyutha e-City Hall nase-Golden Dragon ziyacisha ngesikhathi se-Stage 6—ngaphandle kokuba uhlawule i-R300 ye-Backup Generator Diesel.
tutorial.step5.bullet2: I-Stage 6 Cover Bonus: Ukungenela e-Pier 2 Cold Storage kuthola i-+2 Roll Bonus ngesikhathi se-Stage 6 blackouts ngenxa yokuthi amalambu e-harbour ayacisha.
tutorial.step5.bullet3: SAPS Roadblocks: Uma i-Precinct Heat ifika ku-4+, imigwaqo engaphakathi kwedolobha iyavaleka, kubiza isihlawulo se-R200 namkha indida enye ukuze uthungele ngaphandle kokuba unayo i-SAPS Radio Scanner.
tutorial.step5.desc: Izinga eliphezulu lokutshisa komsebenzi noma lokukhahlamezeka livusa imikhawulo yemigwaqo yamapholisa ye-SAPS phakathi kwamaqoqo. Ukuyiwela kudla idayisi eli-1 noma u-R200 wemiholo yokufihla amehlo ngaphandle kokobana unomshini wokufunda wamapholisa owakopishiweko. Thola idumo elihle lezinto ukuvula amakhono wamasu wangesikhathi e-1/ngelanga njengokuphenduha komsebenzi kanye nokuhamba namapholisa.
tutorial.step5.title: Isinyathelo sesi-5: Amabhuloko Wemigwaqo & Nezinzuzo ZeQembu
tutorial.step6.badge: ISINYATHELO SESI-6 SESI-6 // UMKHIPHI & UKUDLALA KANYE
tutorial.step6.bullet1: Ukuhlula Isenzo sesi-1 & Nokungena Esenzweni sesi-2: Thola imikhondo emibili eqakathekileko yokuvula ukuphela kwe-Berth 14 (I-Vigilante, Whistleblower, noma i-Kingpin), bese uthinta "Qhubekela Esenzweni sesi-2: I-Bluff Refinery →".
tutorial.step6.bullet2: Ukuhlula Isenzo sesi-2: Vula umtlolo we-Island View Pipeline kanye nokuhlola kwe-Petrochemical Mass-Balance ukuvula ukuhlolwa kwePhalamende le-Bluff.
tutorial.step6.bullet3: Umdlalo Omsha+ & Nokubhaliswa Kwabaxazululi: Emva kwanoma yikuphi ukunqoba, hlola ibanga lakho le-Fixer le-S-kuya-ku-C e-eThekwini Fixer Registry, buthelela amabheji wokudumisa ayisi-6, bese uqalisa umdlalo omsha+ ukugcina zonke izixhobo zemakethe emnyuma + nemali eyisipho ye-R1,000!
tutorial.step6.desc: Khuluma nabaxazululi bendawo nabaphathi bamaqembu kunye nendlela ngayinye ukubuza imikhondo, ukubonisa ubufakazi bokuhlolwa, nokubanga izinto ezisiza kanye. Cindezela u-'B' noma uthinte u-'BOARD' nanyana nini ukuze uhlole ibhodi lakho lobugebegu elimnyama, ulandele umkhondo wemali ukusuka e-City Hall ukuya e-Berth 14.
